title: Add 5 to a variable
description: Set score to 10. Add 5 to score by updating the same variable, then print the updated value. The answer should be 15.
hints: Read the task once and identify the Python feature it asks you to practise.
Use a variable and an addition operation before printing.
Write your own code, press Run, and fix any syntax or runtime error shown.
explanation: First score stores 10. The next line calculates 10 + 5 and stores 15 back in the same variable. print(score) runs after that update, so it displays 15.
commonMistakes: Do not print score before adding 5. The second assignment replaces the old value with the new value, so print(score) must come after score = score + 5.

validation.feedback: Use a variable and an addition operation before printing.
